name: ORKL CTI report library
operator: ORKL community project (orkl.eu; operator not verified)
tier_rationale: P293 cond 2 (A8): 'unknown until the registry reviewer records otherwise'. Community-run library whose operator and terms could not be read from the research egress (JS-only site).

reliability.justification: Indexes public CTI reports from their publishers (Malpedia, MITRE, ETDA, VX-Underground mirrors); search is fuzzy, so only exact matches are shown.

error_markers.reason: ORKL: error envelope inside an HTTP 200 answer (status 'error')

library.title: ORKL library search /api/v1/library/search and entry /api/v1/library/entry/{id}

terms.quote: Legal floor (A1): ORKL publishes no terms readable from the research egress (JS-only site), so terms='unknown': the module runs in no profile until legal records the terms in the provider registry.

library.notes: Quote: binding council text (P293 cond 1). Research C0663 (verified_live 200). Observed 2026-11-26: x-ratelimit-limit 300 per 60 s per IP, no ETag; 'data': null = empty; HTTP 406 {status: 'error'} for an empty query. Reports keep their publishers' copyright: titles, dates and publisher links only; the archive.orkl.eu report files are never linked or downloaded (P293 cond 4). While the tier is unknown only CVE and ATT&CK ids are sent (cond 2).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G11-1 (P293 orkl). Unknown tier: never default, excluded at TLP:AMBER and above, neutral UA only. ttl 7 days (P293 cond 3). No quota block: the observed 300/min/IP is far above the module's own min_interval 1 s and daily_quota 500.
